Login Interface
IP address login
1. Open browser and enter 192.168.x.xxx in the address
bar.(Google browser is recommended)
2. Default IP Address: 192.168.56.166
3. Username/Password: Both are “admin”
Console port login
Common serial port software includes SecureCRT and
putty. Take SecureCRT for an example.
Open the SecureCRT, select “New session”.
Select “Serial”, click “Next”.
Select relative COM port, baud rate 115200, flow
control and delete the "V" on the RTS/CTS selection
bar, click “Next”, then click “Ok”
4. Click “Enter”, put in user name/password “admin”.
